mechanism: 15-脂氧合酶（15-LO）抑制劑（小分子），抑制脂質過氧化與鐵依賴性細胞死亡（ferroptosis）路徑、對抗氧化壓力造成的神經損傷
phase: Ph3（長期開放標籤延伸試驗；單一組別、不設盲、無安慰劑對照）
status: 收案已結束、試驗進行中（active, not recruiting）。實際起始 2022/12/08，實際收案 130 人；納入條件為已完成前一個 vatiquinone 試驗並直接轉入（roll-over）的 Friedreich's Ataxia（FA）病人，登錄 14 個站點，橫跨美國（UCLA、佛羅里達大學、南佛羅里達大學、愛荷華大學、費城兒童醫院）、澳洲、巴西、加拿大、法國、德國、義大利、紐西蘭、西班牙；主要完成日與整體完成日均為 2027/12/31。主要目的為長期安全性。⚠️ 登錄自 2025-10-30 起未再更新，狀態欄為主辦方自行維護，不等同現況。⚠️ 本試驗無安慰劑對照、不設盲，設計上不足以證明療效；目前無任何本試驗的結果公開讀出，不得就療效做任何推論。補收說明：本筆為 2026-08-31 依手冊 §1b-2「已知資產點名查核」以藥名查詢補收，先前的疾病條件查詢因排序與更新日之故未撈到。

en.mechanism: A 15-lipoxygenase (15-LO) inhibitor (small molecule) that suppresses lipid peroxidation and the iron-dependent cell-death (ferroptosis) pathway, countering oxidative-stress-driven neuronal injury
en.phase: Ph3 (long-term open-label extension; single group, unmasked, no placebo control)
en.status: Active, not recruiting. Actual start 2022/12/08, with 130 participants actually enrolled; eligibility required Friedreich's ataxia (FA) patients who completed and rolled over directly from a previous vatiquinone study, across 14 registered sites in the United States (UCLA, University of Florida, University of South Florida, University of Iowa, Children's Hospital of Philadelphia), Australia, Brazil, Canada, France, Germany, Italy, New Zealand and Spain; both primary completion and overall completion dates are 2027/12/31. The primary objective is long-term safety. ⚠️ The registry entry has not been updated since 2025-10-30, and the status field is sponsor-maintained, so it does not necessarily describe the present state. ⚠️ This trial has no placebo control and is unmasked, so by design it cannot establish efficacy; no results from it have been read out publicly, and no inference about efficacy should be drawn. Note on capture: this record was added on 2026-08-31 through the drug-name roll call in §1b-2 of the operating manual; the disease-condition queries had missed it because of its sort position and last-update date.

mechanism:
已核准藥物的兒童族群延伸：Nrf2 活化劑（小分子），透過抑制 Keap1 提升 Nrf2 訊號、對抗粒線體功能失調與氧化壓力
原由 Reata Pharmaceuticals 開發，後由 Biogen 收購
phase: Ph3（隨機、雙盲、平行組、四重盲；Part 1 約 1 年隨機期＋Part 2 約 2 年開放標籤延伸）
status: 收案中。實際起始 2025/06/09，登錄預計收案 255 人、2 至 15 歲之 Friedreich's Ataxia（FA）病童與青少年，登錄 33 站，橫跨美國、澳洲、奧地利、巴西、加拿大、丹麥、法國、德國、印度、愛爾蘭、義大利、荷蘭、沙烏地阿拉伯、西班牙、土耳其、英國；主要完成日 2027/11/16；登錄最後更新 2026-06-16。背景：omaveloxolone 已於 2023/02 獲 FDA 核准、2024/02/12 獲歐盟執委會核准，適應症為16 歲以上之 FA，是第一個、也是目前唯一一個獲准的 Friedreich's Ataxia 藥物；本試驗即為向 16 歲以下族群延伸標籤。⚠️ 目前無任何本試驗的療效或安全性結果公開讀出，不得就結果做任何推論。

en.mechanism:
Paediatric extension of an already-approved drug: an Nrf2 activator (small molecule) that raises Nrf2 signalling by inhibiting Keap1, countering mitochondrial dysfunction and oxidative stress
originally developed by Reata Pharmaceuticals and later acquired by Biogen
en.phase: Ph3 (randomised, double-blind, parallel-group, quadruple-masked; Part 1 roughly a one-year randomised period, Part 2 roughly a two-year open-label extension)
en.status: Recruiting. Actual start 2025/06/09, with a registered target of 255 participants aged 2 to 15 with Friedreich's ataxia (FA), across 33 registered sites in the United States, Australia, Austria, Brazil, Canada, Denmark, France, Germany, India, Ireland, Italy, the Netherlands, Saudi Arabia, Spain, Turkey and the United Kingdom; primary completion date 2027/11/16; registry last updated 2026-06-16. Background: omaveloxolone was approved by the FDA in 2023/02 and by the European Commission on 2024/02/12 for FA in patients aged 16 and over, making it the first and so far only approved therapy for Friedreich's ataxia; this trial extends the label to those under 16. ⚠️ No efficacy or safety results from this trial have been read out publicly, and no inference about outcomes should be drawn.

mechanism:
已上市小分子的適應症延伸：N-acetyl-L-leucine 為修飾胺基酸酯，口服顆粒劑（依體重 2–4 g/日）
同成分已以 AQNEURSA® 於 Niemann-Pick C 型上市，本案為向共濟失調適應症延伸
phase: Ph3（樞紐；隨機、雙盲、安慰劑對照、交叉、四重盲）
status: 已收案完畢（登錄狀態 Active, not recruiting）。IB1001-303，實際起始 2025/03/18，登錄預計收案 60 人、4 歲以上基因確診之毛細血管擴張性共濟失調（A-T）病人，合格條件含 SARA 7–34 分；主要指標為 SARA（Period I 第 12 週 vs Period II 第 24 週），次要指標含 SCAFI、ICARS、CGI、EQ-5D、NeuroQOL-UEF；登錄 11 站（美國 UCLA／麻省總醫院／UT Health 休士頓，德國 Cologne／Giessen，斯洛伐克 Bratislava／Košice，西班牙馬德里 La Paz，瑞士 Bern，英國 Cambridge／Nottingham）。公司宣稱本試驗已達主要指標與全部關鍵次要指標，並據以於 2026/05/19 獲 FDA 受理 sNDA＋優先審查、PDUFA 行動日 2026/09/19，另於 2026/06 向 EMA 遞交變更申請。⚠️ 登錄自 2025-07-03 起未再更新，其登錄之主要完成日 2027/12/31 顯已與公司申請進度脫節，不可當成現況；⚠️ 公司僅稱「高度統計顯著」，未公開任何數值、p 值或效果量，本站不代為推估。另公司新聞稿稱收案於 2025/05 啟動、不到兩個月超額收案達 167%、站點為 10 站，與登錄之起始日與站數略有出入，兩者並列不擇一。

en.mechanism:
Label extension of an already-marketed small molecule: N-acetyl-L-leucine, a modified amino-acid ester given as oral granules (2–4 g/day by weight tier)
the same molecule is marketed as AQNEURSA® for Niemann-Pick disease type C; this programme extends it into an ataxia indication
en.phase: Ph3 (pivotal; randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled, crossover, quadruple-masked)
en.status: Enrolment complete (registry status: active, not recruiting). IB1001-303 started 2025/03/18, with a registered target of 60 patients aged 4 and over with genetically confirmed ataxia-telangiectasia (A-T), eligibility requiring a SARA score of 7–34; the primary endpoint is SARA (end of Period I, week 12, versus end of Period II, week 24), with SCAFI, ICARS, CGI, EQ-5D and NeuroQOL-UEF among the secondary endpoints; 11 sites are registered (UCLA, Massachusetts General and UT Health Houston in the US; Cologne and Giessen in Germany; Bratislava and Košice in Slovakia; La Paz in Madrid; Bern in Switzerland; Cambridge and Nottingham in the UK). The company states the trial met its primary endpoint and all key secondary endpoints, and on that basis the FDA accepted an sNDA with Priority Review on 2026/05/19, setting a PDUFA action date of 2026/09/19; a variation application was submitted to the EMA in 2026/06. ⚠️ The registration has not been updated since 2025-07-03, and its registered primary completion date of 2027/12/31 is plainly out of step with the company's filing progress, so it should not be read as current. ⚠️ The company has claimed only 'high statistical significance' and has released no numbers, p-values or effect sizes, which this site does not attempt to infer. The company's press release also describes enrolment as opening in 2025/05 and over-enrolling to 167% in under two months across 10 sites, which differs slightly from the registered start date and site count; both are reported here rather than choosing between them.

mechanism:
AAV5 基因療法：rAAV5-miHTT 經雙側紋狀體一次性給藥，以微小 RNA 降低總 huntingtin 表現
polyQ 疾病中唯一已進入後期的一次性 CNS 基因療法路線
status: 收案結束、追蹤中（Active, not recruiting）。此為 uniQure AMT-130 的歐洲平行試驗，與已收錄之美國試驗 NCT04120493 為同一資產的兩地登錄。隨機、雙盲、劑量探索，實收 14 人、早期顯性亨丁頓舞蹈症成人，起始 2021/10/07，站點在波蘭等歐洲國家；主要指標為安全性與耐受性，次要指標含 CSF 突變型 huntingtin、神經絲輕鏈（NfL）、UHDRS、腦部 MRI 體積。⚠️ 登錄自 2025-03-10 起未再更新，狀態陳述以該日為準；本站收錄理由為 polyQ 圈層一次性基因療法的長期安全性與生物標記走勢，與本社細胞療法屬不同給藥典範。

en.mechanism:
AAV5 gene therapy: rAAV5-miHTT delivered once bilaterally into the striatum, lowering total huntingtin expression via a micro-RNA
the only one-time CNS gene therapy route to have reached late stage in a polyQ disease
en.status: Enrolment closed, in follow-up (active, not recruiting). This is the European companion study to uniQure's AMT-130 programme, registered separately from the US trial NCT04120493 already covered here. It is randomised, double-blind and dose-ranging, with an actual enrolment of 14 adults with early manifest Huntington's disease, started 2021/10/07, at sites in Poland and elsewhere in Europe; the primary endpoints are safety and tolerability, with CSF mutant huntingtin, neurofilament light chain (NfL), UHDRS and brain MRI volumetrics among the secondary measures. ⚠️ The registration has not been updated since 2025-03-10, so the status statement should be read as of that date. It is recorded here for the long-term safety and biomarker trajectory of a one-time gene therapy in the polyQ ring, a delivery paradigm quite distinct from our own cell therapy.

mechanism:
AAVrh.10 基因療法：靜脈輸注遞送 FXN 基因，針對 Friedreich's ataxia 之心肌病變而非神經症狀
與同適應症的神經標的療法互補、非直接競爭
status: 收案結束、追蹤中（Active, not recruiting）。此為 Lexeo 的首次人體劑量探索試驗，是已收錄之 Ph2 試驗 NCT07721025 的前身資料來源。實收 8 人、低／中／高三劑量組，起始 2022/08/24，站點含加州大學共濟失調中心、南佛羅里達大學、Mayo Clinic；主要指標為不良事件與嚴重不良事件，次要指標含 左心室質量指數（LVMi）、左心室射出分率（LVEF）、心臟 MRI 纖維化、心肺運動耐量。⚠️ 登錄自 2025-12-23 起未再更新；n=8 且無對照組，任何療效訊號皆屬探索性。

en.mechanism:
AAVrh.10 gene therapy: an intravenous infusion delivering the FXN gene, aimed at the cardiomyopathy of Friedreich's ataxia rather than its neurological features
complementary to, rather than directly competing with, neurologically targeted therapies in the same indication
en.status: Enrolment closed, in follow-up (active, not recruiting). This is Lexeo's first-in-human dose-ranging study and the source of the data underpinning the Phase 2 trial NCT07721025 already covered here. Actual enrolment was 8 across low, mid and high dose cohorts, started 2022/08/24, at sites including the University of California ataxia centre, the University of South Florida and the Mayo Clinic; the primary endpoints are adverse events and serious adverse events, with left ventricular mass index (LVMi), left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF), cardiac MRI fibrosis and cardiopulmonary exercise tolerance among the secondary measures. ⚠️ The registration has not been updated since 2025-12-23; with n=8 and no control arm, any efficacy signal is exploratory.

mechanism:
蛋白替代療法：外源性 frataxin 融合蛋白經皮下給藥，補足 FXN 基因擴增所導致的 frataxin 缺乏
設計目的為直接回補致病蛋白，而非下游抗氧化
status: 收案中（2026/08/21 新登錄上線，實際起始日 2026/08/05）。這是 Larimar 的全球確認性三期，隨機、雙盲、安慰劑對照、多中心，預計收案 150 人，納入成人與兒童之基因確診（GAA 同型合子）Friedreich's ataxia 病人，合格條件含 mFARS 總分 ≥20 且 <60。雙主要終點皆在第 72 週：mFARS 之 Upright Stability Score（USS，subscale E）自基線變化，以及 mFARS 總分自基線變化。主要完成日預估 2029/07。目前登錄站點僅 3 站、全在美國（Northwestern、Clinilabs、UT Southwestern），依公司說法為全球試驗、站點應會續增。⚠️ 本試驗與該公司已在進行中的加速核准滾動式 BLA 並行——BLA 走的是 frataxin 濃度替代終點，本三期則是核准後仍須完成的臨床療效確認；目前尚無任何本試驗的療效數據。

en.mechanism:
Protein replacement: an exogenous frataxin fusion protein given subcutaneously to restore the frataxin deficiency caused by GAA repeat expansion in FXN
designed to replace the causative protein directly rather than act downstream as an antioxidant
en.status: Recruiting (registration first posted 2026/08/21; actual start date 2026/08/05). This is Larimar's global confirmatory Phase 3 — randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled and multicentre — with a target enrolment of 150 subjects, enrolling adults and children with genetically confirmed (homozygous GAA) Friedreich's ataxia, with eligibility requiring a total mFARS score ≥20 and <60. Both primary endpoints are measured at Week 72: change from baseline in the Upright Stability Score (USS, mFARS subscale E) and change from baseline in total mFARS. Estimated primary completion is July 2029. Only 3 sites, all in the United States, are registered so far (Northwestern, Clinilabs and UT Southwestern); the company describes the study as global, so further sites would be expected. ⚠️ The trial runs in parallel with the company's ongoing rolling BLA for accelerated approval — the BLA rests on a frataxin-concentration surrogate endpoint, whereas this Phase 3 is the clinical confirmation that would still be required post-approval; no efficacy data from this trial exist yet.

status: 已完成（2025/12/17）、主要終點未達標。隨機雙盲安慰劑對照，n=105（eDSP 51／安慰劑 54），收案條件為年滿 6 歲、體重 ≥15 kg 之基因確診 A-T 病人，每 21–30 天靜脈給藥一次共六劑；2024/06/24 起執行於美國、英國、德國、義大利、西班牙、丹麥、挪威、波蘭、瑞士等 9 國 20 站點。主要指標為 6–9 歲族群第 6 個月 RmICARS 自基線變化，結果最小平方均數差 −1.30（95% CI −2.77 至 0.18；p=0.085），未達統計顯著；安全性良好（兩組不良事件率約 92–93%，無治療相關嚴重不良事件）。完整論文 2026/08/14 發表於 The Lancet Child & Adolescent Health。登錄最後更新 2026-04-30

en.mechanism:
Dexamethasone sodium phosphate encapsulated in autologous red blood cells
the erythrocyte acts as a slow-release carrier, giving prolonged low-dose steroid exposure
designed to retain efficacy while avoiding the toxicity of chronic systemic steroids
en.status: Completed 2025/12/17; primary endpoint not met. Randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled, n=105 (51 eDSP, 54 placebo), enrolling genetically confirmed A-T patients aged 6 years or older weighing at least 15 kg, dosed intravenously every 21–30 days for six doses. It ran from 2024/06/24 across 20 sites in nine countries: the USA, UK, Germany, Italy, Spain, Denmark, Norway, Poland and Switzerland. The primary endpoint was change from baseline in RmICARS at month 6 in participants aged 6–9, which returned a least-squares mean difference of −1.30 (95% CI −2.77 to 0.18; p=0.085) — not statistically significant. Safety was favourable (adverse events in roughly 92–93% of both arms, no serious treatment-related events). The full paper appeared in The Lancet Child & Adolescent Health on 2026/08/14. Registry last updated 2026-04-30
